about.title: Where She Came From
paragraphs: Disconnect and step back, without the need to always answer the world.
Return to nature, living at your own authentic frequency.
Dress your true self, styled purely to match your mood.
You don't need to fit into anyone else's box. Change an outfit, swap an accessory, and match your feeling—in the mirror of OFFY, find the version of yourself you truly love.

story.title: The Story of OFFY
story.creatorIntro: Based in Shanghai, Gia began her career in commercial advertising art before moving into toy and collectible design. She is the creator of OFFY.
creatorParagraphs: Gia has always been drawn to the unique charm of dolls and collectibles. To her, they are more than objects to display or collect. They can hold emotions, personalities, and the different ways we imagine ourselves. This idea eventually led her to create OFFY.
Like OFFY, Gia has curly hair and deep skin. People often tell her that she looks just like the character she created.
But Gia sees it a little differently.
Rather than a self-portrait, she hopes OFFY can become a mirror in which everyone can recognize a part of themselves.

Happy, lazy, passionate, or simply not feeling our best on some days. We don't have to be defined by one version of ourselves, and we don't need to change who we are to meet someone else's expectations.
quoteParagraphs: Gia: “Meet Who You Love to Be. That's what OFFY is all about.”
As I continued creating OFFY, I kept wondering what she could be like with different moods, personalities, and feelings.
I imagined her being stubborn, brave, or sometimes shy. She could be sleepy, lost in thought, or simply in the mood to do nothing at all.
On happy days, she'd be ready to embrace the world. On harder days, she might just want to hide away in her own little corner.

I never imagined OFFY as someone who would always stay the same. She could change with her mood, and each version might remind you of who you were yesterday, who you are today, or even who you might be a moment from now.
I hope everyone can find something familiar in OFFY, or perhaps a version of themselves they'd love to become.
story.worldSubtitle: A GIRL FROM BRIAR ISLAND WHO'S ALWAYS HALF ASLEEP.
originParagraphs: If you meet OFFY for the first time, you'll probably notice that she always looks sleepy.
Her curls are a bit messy, her eyes are barely open, and she has this look that says, "I did my best. That's enough for today."
There's actually something personal behind that.
I've always been someone who struggles to wake up in the morning. There are days when all I want is to feel comfortable, without worrying about how I look or trying to appear perfectly put together.
So I decided to put that part of myself into OFFY, too.
I wanted to create a girl who wasn't quite perfect, maybe even a bit untidy.

She doesn't have to be full of energy all the time or ready to take on the world every day. She can have messy hair, feel a little lost, move at her own pace, and have days when she simply doesn't feel like trying.
And she's still just as lovable.
I guess being cute doesn't always mean looking perfectly dressed up. Not every mood or messy moment needs to be fixed.
And so, this sleepy-eyed girl made her way from Briar Island into our world.
islandParagraphs: Briar Island is a rather unusual little island.
It's home to all kinds of fluffy plants. When the wind blows, the grass sways gently, looking almost like someone's hair after a long nap.
Life moves slowly here. Nobody rushes you out of bed in the morning, and nobody expects you to be full of energy all the time.
No one on Briar Island cares much about messy hair. Afternoons drift by in the sun, and sometimes the best thing to do is find a comfortable spot and fall asleep.
Everyone on the island has their own little quirks. Some days, they lose their way in thought or feel a bit defeated. But they're loved just as they are.
OFFY grew up among them, her curls always a little unruly and her eyes heavy with sleep. She's been getting to know the world at her own pace ever since.

reflections.title: WE'RE ALWAYS CHANGING. AND THAT'S WHAT MAKES US FREE.
paragraphs: This is a thought I've always loved.
People are constantly changing. We have happy days and sad days. Sometimes we're full of energy, and sometimes we don't even feel like getting out of bed.
There are days when we look our best, and days when our hair is messy, our eyes are half asleep, and we simply don't feel like dressing up.
But all of these are part of who we are.
I wanted to create a character who could hold all these different feelings and sides of ourselves.
That's how OFFY came to be.
To me, OFFY is more than a girl with a certain look. She's like a container for our moods, personalities, and the different versions of ourselves.
She doesn't have to be happy all the time or always have everything together.
And neither do we.

reflections.title: MORE THAN ONE OFFY. MORE THAN ONE VERSION OF YOU.
paragraphs: As I continued creating OFFY, I began exploring all the different sides of the same girl.
I started experimenting with different outfits, styles, and even different worlds for OFFY.
Some versions of her might look completely different from others, but they're all still OFFY.
She can be brave or shy, full of energy or quiet and sensitive. Some days, she's ready to embrace the world. Other days, she'd rather stay in her own little corner.
I don't see these as different characters. They're simply different sides of the same girl.
After all, we're not exactly the same person every day. How we feel today might be completely different from how we felt yesterday.
I hope that when someone sees OFFY, they'll recognize something familiar and think, "That's so me."

reflections.title: MEET WHO YOU LOVE TO BE.
paragraphs: This is what I hoped to share when I first created OFFY.
I never wanted her to be just a character to look at or collect. I wanted people to feel a connection with her and see something of themselves in her.
You might love her confident side, or feel closer to her when she's sleepy, sensitive, or a little unsure of herself.
And maybe there's an OFFY who reminds you of someone you'd love to become.
I don't think we need to stay the same or always try to be the best version of ourselves.
We can change, explore different sides of ourselves, and sometimes simply do nothing at all.
To me, it's not about finding a perfect version of yourself. It's about being free to choose who you want to be.
That's what I hope everyone can take away from OFFY.
